source: OpenJDK Vulnerability Group advisory 2026-11-17 (https://openjdk.org/groups/vulnerability/advisories/2026-11-17) with the vendor advisories for the November 2026 updates
summary: A heap overflow in the java.util.Base64 decoder's AVX-512 VBMI intrinsic: malformed Base64 reaching the decoder writes past its output buffer. Exploitable only on x86-64 CPUs with AVX-512 VBMI (Intel Ice Lake, Sapphire Rapids and newer; AMD Zen 4 and newer).
